issues.legal_issue: A special administrative procedure for recovering rent arrears does not permit recovery of a debt that is no longer legally recoverable because a suit to recover it is time-barred.
material_facts: A public authority allotted stalls for a monthly licence fee, and the allottee accumulated arrears.
The authority later sought to recover the arrears through a special administrative procedure.
A suit to recover the arrears would have been barred by limitation when the recovery order was made.
issues.conclusion: The special procedure did not create a new right to recover the debt, and the time-barred arrears could not be recovered through it; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: The Limitation Act bars the remedy of a suit without generally extinguishing the underlying right, but whether another remedy remains available depends on the statute providing it. The relevant recovery provision supplied only a special procedure and did not create a right to claim a time-barred debt. In that context, “payable” meant legally recoverable, so the officer had to determine arrears in accordance with law. The Court followed Hans Raj Gupta and others v. Official Liquidator of the Dehradun Mussoorie Electric Tramway Co. Ltd., which held that a provision creating a special payment procedure creates no new rights. Section 28 of the Limitation Act, 1908 did not apply because no suit for possession of property was involved.

predicates.public_premises_rent_recovery_proceeding: A public authority sought to recover an amount through a special administrative procedure for claims relating to public premises.
predicates.rent_arrears_claimed: The amount sought was unpaid rent or a licence fee for the use of public premises.
predicates.ordinary_suit_would_be_time_barred: A suit to recover the claimed arrears would have been barred by limitation.

issues.definition: When a public authority uses a special administrative procedure to claim rent arrears for public premises, and a suit to recover those arrears would be time-barred, the arrears cannot be recovered through that procedure.
